ciFast.note: Fast verification reruns release, format, lint, unit, evaluation, build, and bundle gates after push.

ciDeep.note: Deep proof remains an explicit downstream repository workflow rather than being represented as local browser proof.

deploy.note: Deployment remains downstream of successful repository checks and merge.

liveProvider.note: Fresh opt-in Environmental Microbiology proof forecast 1/5 private-ready lessons plus four source checks, finished 5/5 kernels in about eight seconds, and preserved OpenStax, DOAJ, Europe PMC, and Wikipedia identities in the final ZIP.

manualHuman.note: No instructor, classroom, human-preference, accessibility-certification, or universal factual-validity claim is made.

manualBrowser.note: Desktop and 390x844 Content/Agent/Export frames passed; Agent summarized all five mapped lessons; one export-owned ZIP action downloaded a 55-entry archive with 43 graded files, 38/38 export checks, 99/A, Texture 97, and zero P0/P1/P2 findings.

claims.summary: Algi forecasts the exact private lesson boundary and planned research work before generation.
Opt-in research uses DOAJ, explicitly licensed open-access Europe PMC records, and then Wikipedia only for remaining lesson-contract gaps.
Every researched kernel must pass claim-to-passage entailment and retain a support receipt in addition to quote admission.
The research cascade measures actual lesson-schema composability, preserves later-provider candidates, and rejects same-course but wrong-lesson filler.
Reader-facing quiz and instructional copy are repaired, while generated fallback source rows disappear when trusted concept-linked evidence covers them.
A frozen five-domain Algi-to-Scion benchmark defines immutable evidence packets and honest promotion rules, while recording that paired promotion evidence does not yet exist.
Gemma weights and adapter state remain unchanged; Algi, Scion, and compatible paid providers share compiler, quality, Agent-evidence, and export improvements.

carryForward.item: Measure a compact semantic retriever against held-out paraphrase coverage before accepting its download and memory cost.
Record paired five-domain Algi, Scion, and hybrid benchmark evidence without changing the frozen promotion ruler.
Integrate the hybrid route into production only after it passes the frozen quality, source, latency, call, and export contract.
Add qualified instructor or classroom validation when it becomes available; do not relabel AI-only review as human evidence.
